summary_for_children: As-Saffat means Those Lined Up in Ranks. It tells of Nuh, Ibrahim's trial with his son, Musa and Harun, Ilyas, Lut and Yunus, and how Allah saved them.
environment_concept: A sky adorned with stars above a land of prophets' stories: Nuh's survivors, Ibrahim's trial, the shore where Yunus was cast with a gourd vine.
architecture_and_scenery: Starry dome, an ark on hills, a quiet hilltop recalling Ibrahim's trial through landscape only, a shore with a gourd vine.

areas.name: Gourd Vine
areas.description: A gourd vine growing over a shady spot.

activities.name: Grow the vine
activities.description: Help a gourd vine grow by the shore (adaptation, no person shown).

narration_plan: Narration keeps to the ayahs; no prophet or son is shown. The trial is told only with words from the ayahs.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
